name: Fun In The Sun Day Camp
description_short: A summer day camp run by Manchester Parks & Recreation for Manchester residents in grades 1 to 8. Activities include games, arts and crafts, and swim lessons.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

No session dates, prices or camp location are given. The only address on the page is City Hall (One City Hall Plaza), which may not be where the camp meets.
